subject: pathology
title: Testicular Teratoma, Leydig Cell Tumour, BPH, Prostate Cancer Gleason, PSA, and Penile Cancer

steps.tx: Testicular teratoma differentiates toward somatic tissues of three germ layers, mature in children benignly, postpubertal teratomas metastasising capable despite mature looks and resisting chemotherapy. That age paradox is **postpubertal testicular teratoma**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Mature teratoma in a child forgives; the same looks after puberty can metastasise and ignore chemotherapy.

steps.tx: Leydig cell tumours secrete androgens or oestrogens causing precocious puberty or gynaecomastia, Reinke crystals in pink cytoplasm, mostly benign with malignant minority by size and invasion. Those crystals mark **Leydig cell tumour of testis**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Precocious puberty or gynaecomastia beside a testicular mass thinks Leydig cell tumour and its Reinke crystals.

steps.tx: Benign prostatic hyperplasia nodularly expands transition zone glands and stroma around urethra with age and androgens, obstructing flow while PSA rises from volume not malignancy necessarily. That periurethral growth is **benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH)**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Transition zone nodules strangle the urethra in BPH; cancer prefers the peripheral zone instead.

vis.caption: Benign prostatic hyperplasia enlarging the transition zone around urethra.

steps.tx: Prostatic adenocarcinoma grows peripherally as small crowded glands lacking basal cells, grading by Gleason patterns architecture alone from three obsolete to five fused and cribriform sheets. Architecture grades it: **Gleason grading of prostate cancer**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Gleason grades gland architecture, not cell atypia; pattern four and five rewrite prognosis.

steps.tx: PSA screening detects prostate cancer earlier at overdiagnosis cost, MRI before biopsy and targeted sampling now reducing insignificant diagnoses while active surveillance protects low risk men. That balance is **PSA, MRI, and active surveillance in prostate cancer**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: MRI triage and surveillance discipline PSA's overdiagnosis; not every detected prostate cancer needs treatment.

vis.alt: Normal versus BPH prostate and PSA context
vis.caption: Prostate enlargement and PSA interpretation across benign and malignant disease.

steps.tx: Prostate cancer spreads osteoblastically to axial bones, back pain and cord compression in older men earning PSA and imaging even without urinary symptoms. That bone habit is **osteoblastic metastasis of prostate cancer**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Sclerotic axial metastases in an older man mean prostate primary until PSA and biopsy acquit it.

steps.tx: Penile squamous carcinoma follows phimosis, lichen sclerosus, smoking, and HPV, spreading to inguinal nodes whose involvement decides survival, organ preservation balancing margins. The foreskin cancer is **penile squamous cell carcinoma**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Nonretractile foreskin hiding an ulcer in an older man means penile cancer until biopsy acquits it.

vis.caption: Penile cancer presentation with inguinal nodal spread patterns.

steps.tx: Five alpha reductase inhibitors shrink androgen driven prostate volume while alpha blockers relax outlet tone, surgery or procedures reserving refractory retention and complications. That medical ladder is **BPH medical therapy, alpha blockers and 5-alpha reductase inhibitors**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Relax the outlet fast, shrink the gland slowly: BPH drugs divide labour exactly that way.
